name: structural receptance
domain: 车辆轨道结构与数值方法
definition_zh: 频域中结构位移响应与输入力之间的响应关系。
usage_note: 该文计算轨道格林函数时假定扣件以下混凝土轨道线弹性且无损伤。

complete_examples.text: The structural receptance is defined as the frequency-response curve of the structure which reflects the transfer relationship be tween harmonic load and dynamic response in the linear system.

The Green’s function in the excited fasteners’ point at the track slab can be obtained by the frequency-domain method through the structural receptance, as follows [̂K + iω̂C −ω2̂ M ] R(ω) = P(ω) (18) where R(ω) denotes the structural receptance; P(ω) denotes the generalized force vector; ω is the angular frequency; ̂K, ̂C, and ̂ M are the global stiffness, damping, and mass matrices of the track slab-base system.
